text: What are the canonical parameter values of the Lorenz system used in the lab and text?
explanation: Section 4.2 and lorenz_phase_portrait.py both use sigma = 10 (Prandtl number), rho = 28 (Rayleigh number), beta = 8/3. The other options permute or invent values; swapping sigma and rho (option 1) is a common slip.
